sources.title: GitHub - barlowa124/llm-posttraining: SFT + hand-rolled DPO on a small ...
sources.snippet: Both DPO variants hit 100% preference accuracy on the training pairs while destabilizing the held-out policy in opposite directions — repetition collapse (I I I I I…) at 1e-4, blanket over-abstention at 1e-5. On a 135M model with clean synthetic pairs, the abstain/answer balance is fragile and DPO moves it globally, not per-prompt-type.
